title: Fingerprints: edits that keep every finding in the baseline
description: Creates a baseline, then applies each edit from the "What changes the fingerprint" table of BEP 1498 that must NOT change the fingerprint, and scans again. Every scan after an edit should print 0 new issue(s), 4 in baseline and exit 0 ([gate] failOnSeverity = "LOW" makes any new finding exit 1). The issues: ballerina:13 on the module-level password (line 1), on dbPassword and on the multi-line apiSecret template, and ballerina:1 on the checkpanic in main. Each edit starts from the base sources, so the edits do not add up. Open the Baseline & fingerprints panel to see each finding keep its fingerprint while its line moves. Needs scan 0.15.0+.
upstream: BEP 1498: Finding fingerprints and baseline adoption (ballerina-spec/beps/tool-scan/1498_scan_baseline.md)

steps.name: --create-baseline
steps.note: Saves 4 entries. Never trips the gate, though Scan.toml sets failOnSeverity = "LOW"; every result is unchanged.

steps.name: Lines and a function added above
Scan: lines and a function added above
steps.note: Every finding moves down 6 lines; its fingerprint does not change. Expect 0 new issue(s), 4 in baseline, exit 0.

steps.name: Scan: functions moved within the file
steps.note: connect() and notes() moved below main(). Expect 0 new issue(s), 4 in baseline, exit 0.

steps.name: Scan: re-indented, spacing inside lines
steps.note: Tabs, extra spaces between tokens and `getResult( )`. The text of the tokens is unchanged; the second line of the template is left alone, since spaces there are template content. Expect 0 new issue(s), 4 in baseline, exit 0.

steps.name: Comments and edits on other lines
Scan: comments and edits on other lines
steps.note: Comments and a blank line added, and the line after the flagged one edited. Expect 0 new issue(s), 4 in baseline, exit 0.

steps.name: Comment at the end of a flagged line
Scan: comment at the end of a flagged line
steps.note: A comment is minutiae, not a token. Expect 0 new issue(s), 4 in baseline, exit 0.

steps.name: Scan: enclosing functions renamed
steps.note: connect -> openConnection, notes -> releaseNotes. The enclosing construct is not hashed. Expect 0 new issue(s), 4 in baseline, exit 0.

steps.name: Convert to CRLF
steps.note: Also puts a CRLF inside the multi-line template token, which the fingerprint replaces by LF.

steps.name: --prune-baseline
steps.note: Every entry still matches: "The baseline has no entries to remove", and the file is not rewritten.

steps.name: Add a BOM
steps.note: The first line holds a flagged secret, so the BOM is on a hashed line.

steps.name: Scan: byte order mark
steps.note: Recorded with 2201.13.2: the compiler does not skip a BOM (error: unknown type '?string' at 1:1), so the scan stops before any fingerprint is computed. The fingerprint's BOM handling can only be reached once the compiler accepts it.
